name: threads
description: A lead chat creates real Claude Code sessions, or Codex sessions through a small helper, on chosen models, watches them live and steers them. Shows the apps each thread drives through codex-computer-use. Adapted from promptadvisers/claude-mods-computer-use-threads; see NOTICE.

defaultPermissionMode.title: Default permission mode
defaultPermissionMode.description: Permission mode for new session threads and plan phases unless one sets its own. /threads mode overrides this for the install.

idleCloseMinutes.title: Close idle threads after (minutes)
idleCloseMinutes.description: Finished session threads of this chat that stay idle this long are closed (transcript kept). Working, waiting and pinned threads are never closed. 0 turns it off.
